title: What the set-up page shows
caption: The set-up page (/otas/[id]/setup) mirrors the tenant, its provision job and, for owners and finance, its subscription. Polling (every 2 s) stops at a final state.

states.label: Payment needed
states.detail: M5: job queued at attempt 0 and subscription `incomplete`. Owners: Continue to payment.

states.label: Confirming payment
states.detail: `?checkout=success`: progress polled while Stripe's webhook arrives.

states.label: Setting up (polling)
states.detail: "4 of 9 steps done"; `RATE_LIMITED`/503 keep polling with a note.

states.label: Your OTA is ready
states.detail: Owners: Reveal the test keys (once, within 24 h).

states.label: Set-up failed
states.detail: Step it stopped at, attempts, job id. Owners: Retry the set-up.

states.label: Payment not completed
states.detail: Job `canceled`, subscription `incomplete_expired` (48 h). Owners: Retry (new Checkout).
